name: Wynn, the katana's cut
source: atk_wynn.png (Sacha's sheet, with his katana and the black scabbard drawn in; recoloured with recolor-sprite.mjs): 3 frames in a 2 x 2 sheet (crouched, the blade drawn back low behind him; the wide cut forward at chest height; the follow-through, the blade high behind him), split with split-sheet.mjs --grid 2x2, each sampled on a 4.75 px grid so that his kasa is as wide as in his standing pose (57 pixels at the brim), and put on his palette; all frames cut to columns 17..207 and rows 1..106 of their 237 x 130 grids
